Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

choice noun

the chance to choose

also option, options, have a choice, the choice is yours, it’s up to you, alternative, free choice

classical

Plaut. Cas. 292: optiō haec tua est
Cic. Fin. 1.33: cum solūta nōbīs est ēligendī optiō
Traupman 290: the choice is yours, optiō tua est

optiō, optiōnis f.

noun, third declension

a choice, the right or chance to choose; an option

Optiō tua est or optiō sit tua (Cic. Fat. 3), it’s your choice, it’s up to you; potestātem optiōnemque facere, to give someone the choice (Cic. Div. Caec. 45, Lewis & Short). The masculine optiō is a soldier’s adjutant, another word.

Examples

  • optiō haec tua est: utram hārum vīs condiciōnem accipe

    the choice is yours: take whichever of these terms you likePlaut. Cas. 292

  • cum solūta nōbīs est ēligendī optiō, cumque nihil impedit, quō minus id, quod maximē placeat, facere possīmus

    when our choice is free and nothing prevents us from doing what we like bestCic. Fin. 1.33

  • hodiē, utrō fruī mālīs, optiō sit tua

    today the choice is yours: which of the two would you rather enjoy?Cic. Fat. 3

See also choose, choice, decide, free.

SourcesLewis & Short: optio
